data.title: 篝之雾枝 · 晨雾玫瑰迷宫的微光指尖
data.description: 古堡后方盛开的血红玫瑰迷宫深处，破晓白雾如轻纱弥漫。身着丝绸长袍的雾枝指尖轻拈带露的花瓣，清晨第一缕阳光穿透雾霭，映出吸血鬼少女隐秘的脆弱与优雅。
data.location: blooming red rose labyrinth garden shrouded in mystical morning ground fog at dawn
data.action: strolling through misty rose arbor, delicate fingers lightly caressing a dewy red blossom, wistful distant crimson gaze
data.lighting: 破晓薄雾中的微光与湿润花瓣反光
data.promptProse: Kirie wanders through a fog-laden red rose maze at dawn, her slender fingers caressing a dew-covered rose with quiet, introspective elegance.
data.animaCaption: Morning mist swirls around her crimson robe as her fingers touch the dewy rose petals.
